name: GT-hatcher-hopf-structure-3C4
source:
refs/hatcher-algebraic-topology/AT.txt:17798-17800 VERBATIM: "Theorem 3C.4. If A is a commutative, associative Hopf algebra over a field F of
characteristic 0 , and An is finite-dimensional over F for each n , then A is isomorphic as an algebra to the tensor product of an exterior algebra on odd-dimensional
generators and a polynomial algebra on even-dimensional generators." [Hatcher AT Theorem 3C.4 printed p.284: commutative associative Hopf algebra over char-0 field, degreewise finite-dimensional => isomorphic AS AN ALGEBRA to exterior(odd) tensor polynomial(even). NOTE: exterior-TENSOR-polynomial as an algebra ONLY — polynomial exclusion, generator finiteness, and grading are explicit A1 derivation obligations, not part of this external.]
